name: orca-env-generator
description: Generate editable Blender/MuJoCo photo scenes and primitive ORCA hand RL environments.

interface.shortDescription: Create MuJoCo scenes and RL environments from text or photos
interface.longDescription: Describe a task or upload a tabletop photo. Model common rigid objects in local Blender, review and save edits, then export a mesh-only MuJoCo scene. Existing primitive hand tasks retain separate physics, interface and script checks.
defaultPrompt: Use Blender to model the objects in my photo and open the project for review.
Start a phone photo upload session and show the QR code.
Continue with my saved Blender edits and generate a MuJoCo scene.
Make the ORCA hand close into a fist and open again.
